title: Good marks recorded as explicitly as the gaps (loader.ts trust gates, fail-closed defaults)

finding: Plugin loader trust gates (loader.ts) - reference quality: org-trust regex applied unconditionally; first-party exemption keyed on cortex's own PR-reviewed manifest, with the two spoofable signals (kind/id, arc tier) explicitly rejected and why documented; path-traversal + symlink-escape containment on install dir and manifest file; entry-path containment; and a TOCTOU-closing frozen sanitized copy of the untrusted export.
